_about: The Whispering Woods (levels 12-40): the wood's wardens (the forest guardian, the druid, Theron the hunter) answer each other; the corrupted creatures answer the blight; the shadow beast, corrupted treant and dire wolf are elites; Grimclaw the Great Bear a sub-boss; and the Blightlord at the Heart of Corruption spreads blight across the ground and grows treants out of it.
